spark.scope: Native Spark SQL on 30 cached JDBC source tables; native windows/joins/standardization/PCA/KMeans; pandas/NumPy/SciPy science on Spark Python workers; Spark JDBC decision publication. Facts shared within each domain/parameter batch of 10 business questions; original-data DuckDB references and independent native ML checks.

holistic.scope: Customer/product fact graphs plus a transaction bridge; independent native pandas reconstructions; credit calibration→robust demand forecast→128×14×80 correlated tensor→credit/supply shocks→CVaR epigraph LP→integer procurement→cash/energy/carbon/plant constraints→transaction publication. Excluded from main 10000 and Spark 200.

joined.scope: Single SQL with nested scoped CTEs for 30-source customer/product/purchase graph; independent native pandas reconstruction; robust PCA/exposure pivot and constrained resource allocation; transaction roundtrip. Separate from main/Spark/holistic counts.

environment.build_source_note: Results apply to the binary build commit. Checkout differs and was not rebuilt for this batch.

performance.scope: 19-source-table SQL reads + DataFrame + science; pandas also includes its independent source-graph reconstruction from a verified shared source snapshot. Connection initialization, source snapshot acquisition, reference checking and transaction publication excluded from per-case latency. Throughput wall-time includes scheduling/connection/release overhead. Full reference/constraint checks run only after each timed batch ends. No concurrent compatibility clients or source audits.

scope.main: 20 questions ×500 configurations. Each complete case has one 19-table wide fact graph, a scientific decision chain and transaction publication. Native pandas source facts shared per parameter/domain. Every MO graph executed for every main case.
